From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 08:17:00 -07:00
Subject: INTERNAL: proposed intake flags and quick redline plan (do not send to Acme yet)

Marcus / Jordan —

I reviewed the attached MSA and sketched a short intake plan to speed up turnaround once Acme returns redlines. Key items below — I recommend we prepare a marked-up response that addresses these up-front.

Pre-populate on our side (template flags):
- SLA: standard 99.9% uptime for API (exclusion for scheduled maintenance with 48h notice). Show tier for 99.99% if they commit to dedicated capacity.
- Breach notification: 72 hours for incident detection + 30 days for forensics report (we can be flexible to 72/14 if needed).
- Liability cap: our standard is lesser of $5M or 12 months' fees. If they push 12 months flat, push to sales for approval on the deal_id ACME-2026-042.
- Data residency exhibit: prepare three options (US-only, multi-region with EU and US, and customer-managed VPC). I started a stub exhibit — link below.

Risk sections to watch for in their redlines: broad indemnity language, contractually binding SLAs with monetary credits without escrow, and IP assignment language in the dev/feature section.

Next steps:
- Marcus: reply to Acme with short answers on residency and liability cap (see suggested language below).
- Jordan: if Acme requests 12 months cap unconditionally, can you escalate to Sales Ops for an exception?
- I’ll finish the residency exhibit and upload to the shared Drive by 12:00 PDT.

Suggested short replies to Acme: 
"Redwood can offer a US-only hosting option as an exhibit; we typically cap liability at the lesser of $5M or 12 months' fees — we can review exceptions for material enterprise customers through Sales Ops."

Drive draft: https://drive.google.com/example/Acme-MSA-draft (internal edit access)

Thanks — I’ll have the exhibit by noon.

Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Commercial Contracts | Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com

2) Liability cap: Our standard position is the lesser of $5M or 12 months' fees. We can consider exception requests but those will need Sales Ops approval (I’ve cc'd Jordan for escalation).

Proposed timeline (confirmed):
- Acme initial redlines due: Thu, Jul 1 EOD (if that’s not workable, please let us know and propose a date).
- Redwood marked-up response delivered: Tue, Jul 6.
